name: singularity
description: Singularity AI IDE — VS Code fork + routing + AI I/O cache

scripts.build:prompt: npm run build:cache && npm run build -w @singularity/prompt
scripts.build:memory: npm run build:cache && npm run build:context && npm run build -w @singularity/memory
scripts.build:architecture: npm run build:memory && npm run build -w @singularity/architecture
scripts.build:outcome: npm run build:context && npm run build -w @singularity/outcome
scripts.build:execution: npm run build -w @singularity/runtime && npm run build -w @singularity/execution
scripts.build:intelligence: npm run build:prompt && npm run build:architecture && npm run build:outcome && npm run build -w @singularity/intelligence
scripts.build:router: npm run build:prompt && npm run build -w @singularity/router
scripts.build:runtime: npm run build:design && npm run build:context && npm run build:wiki && npm run build:intelligence && npm run build:neural-relay && npm run build -w @singularity/runtime
scripts.build:packages: npm run build:runtime && npm run build:execution && npm run build:brain
scripts.build:extension: npm install --prefix vscode/extensions/singularity-ai && npm run build --prefix vscode/extensions/singularity-ai
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run sync:extension
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:extension
scripts.test:packages: npm run test -w @singularity/cache && npm run test -w @singularity/prompt && npm run test -w @singularity/design && npm run test -w @singularity/context && npm run test -w @singularity/wiki && npm run test -w @singularity/router && npm run test -w @singularity/runtime && npm run test -w @singularity/memory && npm run test -w @singularity/architecture && npm run test -w @singularity/outcome && npm run test -w @singularity/intelligence && npm run test -w @singularity/neural-relay && npm run test -w @singularity/brain
scripts.typecheck:packages: npm run typecheck -w @singularity/cache && npm run typecheck -w @singularity/prompt && npm run typecheck -w @singularity/design && npm run typecheck -w @singularity/context && npm run typecheck -w @singularity/wiki && npm run typecheck -w @singularity/router && npm run typecheck -w @singularity/runtime && npm run typecheck -w @singularity/memory && npm run typecheck -w @singularity/architecture && npm run typecheck -w @singularity/outcome && npm run typecheck -w @singularity/intelligence && npm run typecheck -w @singularity/neural-relay && npm run typecheck -w @singularity/brain
scripts.watch: npm run build:packages && npm --prefix vscode run watch
scripts.compile: npm run build && npm --prefix vscode run compile
